items.html: We find that three parts of it became soul within soul, in the upper half of the Tifferet of Arich, for AVI; and the three lower parts became a soul for the lower half of the Tifferet of Arich, which becomes the three Mochin for ZA, as mentioned. And also, from the NH of Atik, which are within the NH of Arich, a soul was made for ZA, too. And all this will be explained at length in its true place, in the matter of the Gadlut of ZA. And thus the clothing of ZA in Arich and in Atik at the time of the pregnancy has been explained very well.
